description: Source code for a Vault class implementation managing cryptographic data blobs, including import/export, size retrieval, and disposal, with external C interface functions.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Singleton class managing cryptographic data blobs with thread safety, import/export, and size management.

methods.name: Vault::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Vault class.

methods.name: Vault::Vault
methods.description: Constructor initializing private keys and internal data structures.

methods.name: Vault::Cipher
methods.description: Performs a placeholder cipher operation (copy) on input data.

methods.name: Vault::Size
methods.description: Retrieves size of stored blob by id, considering sealed/exportable status.

methods.name: Vault::Import
methods.description: Imports data blob, encrypts, and stores it with an auto-incremented handle.

methods.name: Vault::Export
methods.description: Exports data blob by id, decrypting if necessary.

methods.name: Vault::Put
methods.description: Stores a sealed data blob and returns its assigned id.

methods.name: Vault::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a sealed data blob by id.

methods.name: Vault::Dispose
methods.description: Removes a data blob by id from storage.
